avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance immune stimulation and potentiate durvalumab's immune activation, increasing risk of immune-related adverse events (irAEs)
avoid_supplements.action: Advise patient to discontinue echinacea during durvalumab therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Astragalus
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immunostimulatory properties may synergistically amplify PD-L1 inhibitor effects and exacerbate autoimmune-like reactions
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel on alternative immune-supportive approaches

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin D supplements (>2000 IU daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May augment immune activation and potentially increase irAE risk; immunomodulatory effects
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to RDA levels; monitor calcium and phosphate; baseline and periodic vitamin D assessment recommended

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modulate gut microbiota composition; emerging evidence suggests microbiota may influence immunotherapy response and irAE development
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor for GI symptoms; inform oncology team of probiotic use

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin/Turmeric
caution_supplements.mechanism: Anti-inflammatory properties may theoretically interfere with immune activation, but clinical significance with PD-L1 inhibitors unclear
caution_supplements.action: Use in moderation; avoid high-dose supplementation; monitor for efficacy changes

caution_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate hypertension and cardiovascular irAEs in susceptible patients; sodium can promote Th17 differentiation
caution_foods.action: Encourage low-sodium diet; monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: Charred/grilled meats
caution_foods.mechanism: Heterocyclic amines and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons may modulate immune response, though clinical relevance with durvalumab is unclear
caution_foods.action: Recommend moderate intake; advise cooking methods that minimize carcinogen formation

monitoring_notes: Durvalumab is not hepatically metabolized via CYP enzymes, so traditional drug-supplement interactions are minimal; however, immunomodulatory supplements may amplify immune-related adverse events including colitis, pneumonitis, and hepatitis. Close monitoring for irAEs is essential, particularly with immune-stimulating botanical products.
